ground_truth.description: Oracle implementation allows price manipulation through insufficient validation of historical tick data or insufficient protection against rapid sequential updates.
ground_truth.root_cause: Oracle implementation allows price manipulation through insufficient validation of historical tick data or insufficient protection against rapid sequential updates.
ground_truth.fix_description: Implement stricter validation of oracle updates, add rate-limiting on sequential updates.
